## Engineering Core Philosophy
1. **Evidence Before Confidence**: Output must trace back to vector retrieval, knowledge graphs, or explicit assumptions rather than ungrounded model completion.
2. **Deterministic Where It Matters**: Guardrails, release gates, and validation schemas must be deterministic; models should be used for linguistic transformation and contextual extraction.
3. **Human Review for Consequential Actions**: Consequential mutations require explicit human review states, permission scopes, and immutable audit logs.
4. **Evaluation Over Vibes**: Rigorous deterministic test harnesses (retrieval recall, concept extraction accuracy, gate precision) over subjective demo reviews.

## Flagship Systems

### 1. Civitas — Multimodal Spatial Incident Intelligence Engine
- **Focus**: Zero-trust civic intake pipeline converting unverified citizen WhatsApp reports, geotagged photos, and voice notes into auditable municipal work orders.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, FastAPI, PostGIS, pgvector, H3 Hexagonal Hierarchical Spatial Index, LangGraph, Supabase.
- **Key Architecture**: Binary magic-byte & EXIF verification, H3 hexagonal hotspot clustering, BM25+Dense RRF policy routing, tamper-evident SHA-256 digital seals.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Dhruvg334/Civitas
- **Live Demo**: https://civitas-delta.vercel.app

### 2. Mnemos — Industrial GraphRAG & Operational Intelligence
- **Focus**: Turning complex industrial maintenance records, manuals, and field knowledge into evidence-backed investigation traces.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, pgvector, Neo4j, LangChain.
- **Key Architecture**: Hybrid vector-graph retrieval, entity-relationship extraction, provenance node inspection, governed agent traces.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Dhruvg334/mnemos
- **Live Demo**: https://mnemos-lake.vercel.app

### 3. A-DAP-T — AI Agent Safety & Release Readiness Review
- **Focus**: Pre-release audit scanner for agentic applications surfacing risky tools, missing approval gates, prompt injection risks, and credential exposures.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, TypeScript, FastAPI, Firebase, Gemini API.
- **Key Architecture**: Deterministic AST & rule-based review engine, ALLOW/REVIEW/BLOCK release decisions, human-in-the-loop review reports.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Dhruvg334/a-dap-t
- **Live Demo**: https://a-dap-t.vercel.app

### 4. EduSynth (Tessarion) — Source-Grounded Learning & Evaluation Suite
- **Focus**: Active recall learning platform where users teach concepts back, receive source-grounded diagnosis, and inspect concept relationships with full evaluation suites.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, Supabase, Qdrant, Neo4j, Vitest.
- **Key Architecture**: Deterministic evaluation suite measuring retrieval precision, concept extraction accuracy, diagnosis validity, and mastery recovery.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Dhruvg334/Tessarion
- **Live Demo**: https://tessarion.vercel.app

### 5. ChronOS — Controlled Agentic Planning & Execution Recovery
- **Focus**: Adaptive execution system converting commitments, calendar constraints, and working preferences into realistic plans with approval-based recovery.
- **Tech Stack**: React, FastAPI, Supabase, pgvector, Google Calendar API.
- **Key Architecture**: Model-assisted planning bounded by deterministic collision, capacity, dependency, and protected-time validators.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Dhruvg334/chronos

### 6. Niswarth AI — Full-Stack AI Workflows & NGO Governance
- **Focus**: NGO campaign, volunteer, and field update coordination platform with human-reviewed impact reporting inside tenant-isolated workspaces.
- **Tech Stack**: React, Vite, Supabase (Row-Level Security), Gemini API, GitHub Actions.
- **Key Architecture**: RLS multi-tenant security, draft/review/approval states, immutable AI action logs, automated deployment CI.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Dhruvg334/Niswarth-AI
- **Live Demo**: https://niswarth-ai.vercel.app
